# hamLLM package snapshot

Source: `tristanmcmahon/hamLLM` at commit
`4f2f931226a677241d829a227a7c7a8fe03a8943`.

This is a package source snapshot, not a second implementation. Application
changes belong in hamLLM. When updating the snapshot, copy the upstream
`pyproject.toml`, `README.md`, and `src/hamllm/` together; then run hamLLM's
tests and the Helix checks before switching the system.
